data.name: openToolStripMenuItem.ToolTipText
data.value: Brings up a dialogue where you can select which ROM the emulator will use. Automatically starts the emulator when a ROM is loaded.

data.name: fileToolStripMenuItem.ToolTipText
data.value: Select a path to load the ROM from

data.name: hardResetToolStripMenuItem.ToolTipText
data.value: Completely resets RAM and registers. This is equivalent to switching real hardware off, leaving it, and turning it on again.

data.name: pauseToolStripMenuItem.ToolTipText
data.value: Pause: Stops the current action and allows it to be resumed later. Play: Resumes from the point that the gameplay was paused at

data.name: advanceFrameToolStripMenuItem.ToolTipText
data.value: When paused, this allows for a single frame to be processed and rendered.

data.name: throttlerToolStripMenuItem.ToolTipText
data.value:
The throttler ensures that the emulator runs at framerate similar to that of real hardware.
Disabling this will run the emulator at the highest speed your hardware can do, which can be useful if you need to run things quickly, but it may make gameplay difficult or impossible.
